title: {ticker}: your own bond, a whole life in minutes
lead: A real series on Solana devnet whose <clock>demo clock</clock> runs one bond day in {s} s, so its year passes in about six minutes. Same program, same maths, same steps as a real bond.
stale: The registrar did not answer the last update. The page keeps trying every few seconds.

now.issued: {ticker} is placed: {units} bonds with {holders} investors. The autopilot announces coupon 1 next.
now.announced: {action} is announced. The record date comes by itself and trading never stops.
now.snapshot: Record date passed: {done} of {count} holders snapshotted on-chain.
now.funding: Snapshot final: {count} holders, Σ {units} bonds = supply. The issuer funds {amount} ₸ now.
now.skipped: Funding skipped: the escrow holds 0 of {amount} ₸. One bond day after the payment date anyone can record the default.
now.defaulted: {action} is in default: {amount} ₸ short. The bond keeps trading; the record-date holders keep their claims.
now.funded: The escrow holds {amount} ₸. Anyone can push the payout to {count} holders.
now.bank: {who} chose the bank route: {amount} ₸ is with the paying agent until it confirms the bank transfer.
now.claim: Your {amount} ₸ is ready: claim it with your wallet, or the autopilot pays it in a minute.
now.complete: Every holder is paid. Anyone can complete {action}.
now.paid: {action} paid: {net} ₸ to {count} holders and {tax} ₸ to the tax vault.
now.redeemed: Redeemed: the last coupon and the principal are paid and every bond burned in the same transaction. The series is closed.

who.anyone: Any wallet may send this step; the program checks every rule. Here the autopilot sends it.
who.issuer: The issuer signs this step. In the sandbox the autopilot plays the issuer.
who.payingAgent: The paying agent confirms once its bank transfer is made.
who.holder: Only the holder's own wallet can claim it.

detail.hook: The transfer hook snapshots each position before it moves
detail.burned: Bonds burned in the same transaction

flowEmpty: No corporate action yet: the autopilot announces coupon 1 in a moment.

try.title: Try it yourself
try.lead: Each button changes your bond on devnet. The result names what the program did and links the transaction.

skip_funding.title: Skip the funding
skip_funding.what: The autopilot stops funding the next coupon. One bond day after its payment date anyone can record the <term>default</term> on-chain.

cure.title: Cure the default
cure.what: The issuer funds the shortfall late. The program records the <term>cure</term> and pays the record-date holders.

non_kyc_transfer.title: Send to a wallet without KYC
non_kyc_transfer.what: Try to move 1 bond to an outsider. Token-2022 and the <term>transfer hook</term> keep bonds with registered investors only.

dvp_trade.title: Trade 5 bonds with accrued
dvp_trade.what: A delivery-versus-payment trade at clean 100 % plus <term>accrued interest</term>. The program emits TradeAccrued.

why.nothingToFund: No coupon is left to fund

result.skipped: Armed: the autopilot will not fund the next coupon. Watch the Now bar for the default.
result.cured: DefaultCured on-chain: the issuer funded late and the record-date holders are paid.
result.refused: Refused ({error}): an outsider's bond account stays frozen, so no bond moved.
result.traded: Settled: {units} bonds for {cash} ₸ = {clean} clean + {accrued} accrued ({days} days, 30E/360).
result.exCoupon: Negative accrued: inside the ex-coupon window the seller keeps the coupon.

register.title: Register at the record date
register.lead: At the <rd>record date</rd> every position is snapshotted on-chain and becomes an <ent>entitlement</ent>: gross, the tax withheld and the net paid.
register.empty: No snapshot yet: the rows appear here one by one, holder by holder, once the record date passes.

anyone.title: Anyone can push
anyone.body: Strike, snapshot, finalize, pay, complete and declaring a default are <term>permissionless</term>: any wallet can send them and the program checks every rule. Money only goes where the program says.

issuer.title: Issuer
issuer.body: The issuer funds each coupon into the action's escrow. The sandbox autopilot signs as the issuer unless you skip the funding.
issuer.auto: The autopilot funds it right after the snapshot.
issuer.skipped: Funding skipped: this coupon will default.
issuer.cured: Funded late: the default is cured.
issuer.before: The amount due is fixed by the snapshot at the record date of {action}.
issuer.none: Nothing is due before coupon 1 is announced.

registrar.title: Registrar and paying agent
registrar.body: The registrar keeps the register: only KYC-attested investors hold bonds. At the record date the <term>transfer hook</term> snapshots each position before it moves, so trading never pauses.

investor.title: Investor
investor.walletLead: Add your own wallet as a fourth holder: a new sandbox registers it, gives it 5 bonds and test tenge, and lets you claim the coupon yourself.

feed.title: Transactions
feed.lead: Every step is a devnet transaction.

tx.SeriesClosed: Close the series: every bond redeemed
tx.refused: Transfer to a wallet without KYC refused: {error}

start.title: Creating your bond on devnet
start.lead: A fresh series of your own, on a demo clock. It usually takes under a minute; then the bond lives a whole year in about six.
start.working: The registrar is sending the transactions…

series.title: Create the series
series.body: 1,000 ₸ face, 10 % semi-annual, one year; one bond day lasts a second.

investors.title: Register three investors
investors.body: Each gets an on-chain KYC attestation (the KYC check itself is simulated).

place.title: Place 10, 25 and 65 bonds
place.body: One investor is a non-resident fund: 15 % tax and payouts through the paying agent's bank.

wallet.title: Add your wallet
wallet.body: Registered as a fourth holder with 5 bonds and test tenge from the faucet.

autopilot.title: Hand it to the autopilot
autopilot.body: Record dates, snapshots, funding and payouts run by themselves; you can interfere.

start.throttled: Three sandboxes per visitor per hour keep devnet fees in check. Try again in a few minutes, or read how a bond lives on Qupon meanwhile.
start.learn: How a bond lives on Qupon

gone.title: This sandbox has ended
gone.body: Sandboxes live for 24 hours. Start a new one: it takes a minute.
